import low_level = "./low_level.qui"

class Conflict(string kind, int tick, int first, int second, int source, int destination)
class Constraint(int agent, string kind, int tick, int source, int destination)
class Node(int[][] paths, low_level.Prohibitions[] constraints, int cost, Conflict[] conflicts, int number, int depth, int parent)

int path_position(int[] path, int tick)
    index := if tick < int(#path) then tick else int(#path) - 1
    return path[index]

int plan_soc(int[][] paths)
    result := 0
    for path := paths[]
        result += int(#path) - 1
    return result

int plan_makespan(int[][] paths)
    result := 0
    for path := paths[]
        length := int(#path) - 1
        if length > result
            result = length
    return result

int plan_cost(int[][] paths, string cost_function)
    return if cost_function == "SOC" then plan_soc(paths) else plan_makespan(paths)

Conflict[] find_conflicts(int[][] paths)
    Conflict[] result := []
    horizon := plan_makespan(paths)
    for: 1 <= tick <= horizon
        for: first < int(#paths)
            for: first + 1 <= second < int(#paths)
                a := path_position(paths[first], tick)
                b := path_position(paths[second], tick)
                if a == b
                    result = result.append(Conflict("vertex", tick, first, second, a, a))
                elif a == path_position(paths[second], tick - 1) and b == path_position(paths[first], tick - 1)
                    result = result.append(Conflict("edge", tick, first, second, path_position(paths[first], tick - 1), a))
    return result

Constraint[] split_constraints(Conflict conflict)
    if conflict.kind == "vertex"
        return [Constraint(conflict.first, "vertex", conflict.tick, conflict.source, conflict.source), Constraint(conflict.second, "vertex", conflict.tick, conflict.source, conflict.source)]
    return [Constraint(conflict.first, "edge", conflict.tick, conflict.source, conflict.destination), Constraint(conflict.second, "edge", conflict.tick, conflict.destination, conflict.source)]

Node create_node(int[][] paths, low_level.Prohibitions[] constraints, int number, int depth, int parent, string cost_function)
    return Node(paths, constraints, plan_cost(paths, cost_function), find_conflicts(paths), number, depth, parent)

bool node_before(Node first, Node second)
    if first.cost != second.cost
        return first.cost < second.cost
    if #first.conflicts != #second.conflicts
        return #first.conflicts < #second.conflicts
    return first.number < second.number

void push_node(Node[] &heap, Node node)
    heap = heap.append(node)
    position := int(#heap) - 1
    while position > 0
        parent := (position - 1) / 2
        if not node_before(heap[position], heap[parent])
            break
        temporary := heap[parent]
        heap[parent] = heap[position]
        heap[position] = temporary
        position = parent

Node pop_node(Node[] &heap)
    result := heap[0]
    last := int(#heap) - 1
    replacement := heap[last]
    heap = heap[0:<last]
    if last > 0
        heap[0] = replacement
        position := 0
        while position * 2 + 1 < last
            child := position * 2 + 1
            if child + 1 < last and node_before(heap[child + 1], heap[child])
                child += 1
            if not node_before(heap[child], heap[position])
                break
            temporary := heap[position]
            heap[position] = heap[child]
            heap[child] = temporary
            position = child
    return result

class Grid(int width, int height, string[] rows, bool[] free, int[][] destinations)
class Agent(int id, int start, int goal, string name)

string[] input_lines(string filename)
    string text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/" + filename))
    rows := text.split(NL)
    return rows[0:<int(#rows) - 1]

Grid read_grid()
    rows := input_lines("map.txt")
    dimensions := rows[0].split(" ")
    width := int(dimensions[0])
    height := int(dimensions[1])
    rows = rows[1:]
    bool[] free := []
    for: y < height
        for: x < width
            free = free.append(rows[y][x] == ".")
    int[][] destinations := []
    dx := [0, 0, 1, 0, -1]
    dy := [0, -1, 0, 1, 0]
    for: cell < width * height
        int[] adjacent := []
        if free[cell]
            for: action < 5
                x := cell % width + dx[action]
                y := cell / width + dy[action]
                if x >= 0 and x < width and y >= 0 and y < height and free[y * width + x]
                    adjacent = adjacent.append(y * width + x)
        destinations = destinations.append(adjacent)
    return Grid(width, height, rows, free, destinations)

Agent[] read_agents(Grid grid)
    rows := input_lines("agents.csv")
    Agent[] result := []
    names := "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRST"
    for: 1 <= i < int(#rows)
        fields := rows[i].split(",")
        id := int(fields[0])
        int start := int(fields[2]) * grid.width + int(fields[1])
        int goal := int(fields[4]) * grid.width + int(fields[3])
        result = result.append(Agent(id, start, goal, names[id]))
    return result

int degree(Grid grid, int cell)
    return int(#grid.destinations[cell]) - 1

int[] distance_table(Grid grid, int goal)
    result := array(#grid.free, fill = -1)
    result[goal] = 0
    queue := [goal]
    cursor := 0
    while cursor < int(#queue)
        current := queue[cursor]
        cursor += 1
        for adjacent := grid.destinations[current][]
            if result[adjacent] < 0
                result[adjacent] = result[current] + 1
                queue = queue.append(adjacent)
    return result

import grid_map = "./grid_map.qui"

class Prohibitions(int cell_count)
    states := distinct<int>()
    moves := distinct<int>()
    permanent := map<int, int>()

class Budget(int limit)
    searches := 0
    expansions := 0

class SearchResult(string status, int[] path, int expansions)
class SearchNode(int cell, int tick, int f, int g, int number, int parent)

bool state_allowed(Prohibitions restrictions, int cell, int tick)
    if restrictions.states.has(tick * restrictions.cell_count + cell)
        return false
    match restrictions.permanent.get(cell)
        int start
            return tick < start
        none
            return true

bool action_allowed(Prohibitions restrictions, int source, int destination, int tick)
    if not state_allowed(restrictions, destination, tick)
        return false
    key := (tick * restrictions.cell_count + source) * restrictions.cell_count + destination
    return source == destination or not restrictions.moves.has(key)

int arrival_allowed(Prohibitions restrictions, int goal)
    result := 0
    for key := restrictions.states.values()[]
        if key % restrictions.cell_count == goal
            next := key / restrictions.cell_count + 1
            if next > result
                result = next
    return result

void reserve_path(Prohibitions &restrictions, int[] path, start_tick := 0, permanent := false)
    cells := restrictions.cell_count
    for: step < int(#path)
        tick := start_tick + step
        .restrictions.states.add(tick * cells + path[step])
        if step > 0 and path[step] != path[step - 1]
            .restrictions.moves.add((tick * cells + path[step]) * cells + path[step - 1])
    if permanent
        goal := path[-1]
        start := start_tick + int(#path) - 1
        match restrictions.permanent.get(goal)
            int previous
                if previous < start
                    start = previous
            none
                void
        .restrictions.permanent.set(goal, start)

bool search_before(SearchNode first, SearchNode second)
    if first.f != second.f
        return first.f < second.f
    if first.g != second.g
        return first.g > second.g
    return first.number < second.number

void push_open(SearchNode[] &heap, SearchNode node)
    heap = heap.append(node)
    position := int(#heap) - 1
    while position > 0
        parent := (position - 1) / 2
        if not search_before(heap[position], heap[parent])
            break
        temporary := heap[parent]
        heap[parent] = heap[position]
        heap[position] = temporary
        position = parent

SearchNode pop_open(SearchNode[] &heap)
    result := heap[0]
    last := int(#heap) - 1
    replacement := heap[last]
    heap = heap[0:<last]
    if last > 0
        heap[0] = replacement
        position := 0
        while position * 2 + 1 < last
            child := position * 2 + 1
            if child + 1 < last and search_before(heap[child + 1], heap[child])
                child += 1
            if not search_before(heap[child], heap[position])
                break
            temporary := heap[position]
            heap[position] = heap[child]
            heap[child] = temporary
            position = child
    return result

SearchResult search_path(grid_map.Grid grid, grid_map.Agent agent, int[] distances, int start, int start_tick, Prohibitions restrictions, int maximum_tick, Budget &budget, window := false)
    budget.searches += 1
    beginning := budget.expansions
    arrival := arrival_allowed(restrictions, agent.goal)
    root := SearchNode(start, start_tick, distances[start], 0, 0, -1)
    heap := [root]
    generated := [root]
    distinct<int> seen
    cells := int(#grid.free)
    .seen.add(start_tick * cells + start)
    while #heap != 0
        current := pop_open(&heap)
        budget.expansions += 1
        expanded := budget.expansions - beginning
        if budget.limit >= 0 and budget.expansions > budget.limit
            return SearchResult("aborted", [], expanded)
        if (current.cell == agent.goal and current.tick >= arrival) or (window and current.tick == maximum_tick)
            int[] reversed := []
            cursor := current.number
            while cursor >= 0
                reversed = reversed.append(generated[cursor].cell)
                cursor = generated[cursor].parent
            return SearchResult("ok", reversed[::-1], expanded)
        if current.tick == maximum_tick
            continue
        for destination := grid.destinations[current.cell][]
            tick := current.tick + 1
            key := tick * cells + destination
            if distances[destination] < 0 or seen.has(key) or not action_allowed(restrictions, current.cell, destination, tick)
                continue
            .seen.add(key)
            number := int(#generated)
            g := tick - start_tick
            node := SearchNode(destination, tick, g + distances[destination], g, number, current.number)
            generated = generated.append(node)
            push_open(&heap, node)
    return SearchResult("no_path", [], budget.expansions - beginning)

import collections
import grid_map = "./grid_map.qui"
import low_level = "./low_level.qui"
import cbs = "./cbs.qui"
import prioritized = "./prioritized.qui"
import report = "./report.qui"

class RunDefinition(string solver, string cost_function)
class Delay(int agent, int start, int duration)
class Parameters(int horizon, int high_budget, int low_budget, int window, int step, int[][] orders, RunDefinition[] runs, string animate, int frames, Delay[] delays)
class Mdd(int[][] layers, int states, int width)
class AgentMetrics(int cost, int extra, int waits, int turns, int arrival, int leaves, string actions)
class PlanMetrics()
    AgentMetrics[] agents := []
    cost := 0
    soc := 0
    makespan := 0
    sum_extra := 0
    max_extra := 0
    waits := 0
    turns := 0
    int[] arrivals := []
    int[] traffic := []
    int[] cell_waits := []
    int[] hotspots := []

class Execution()
    deadlock := false
    cutoff := 0
    soc := 0
    makespan := 0
    blocked := 0
    int[] finish := []

class Run(RunDefinition definition, int low_budget)
    string name := definition.solver + "-" + definition.cost_function
    success := false
    reason := ""
    int[][] paths := []
    budget := low_level.Budget(low_budget)
    high_level := 0
    generated := -1
    pruned := 0
    open_count := 0
    classes := [0, 0, 0]
    answer_number := -1
    answer_depth := 0
    answer_order := 0
    low_level.Prohibitions[] constraints := []
    string[] specific := []
    trace := ["run " + name]
    metrics := PlanMetrics()
    execution := Execution()

Parameters read_parameters(int count)
    horizon := 0
    high_budget := 0
    low_budget := 0
    window := 0
    step := 0
    int[][] orders := []
    int[] number_order := []
    for: i < count
        number_order = number_order.append(i)
    orders = orders.append(number_order)
    RunDefinition[] runs := []
    animate := ""
    frames := 0
    Delay[] delays := []
    for row := grid_map.input_lines("params.txt")[]
        fields := row.split(" ")
        kind := fields[0]
        if kind == "HORIZON"
            horizon = int(fields[1])
        elif kind == "HL_BUDGET"
            high_budget = int(fields[1])
        elif kind == "LL_BUDGET"
            low_budget = int(fields[1])
        elif kind == "WINDOW"
            window = int(fields[1])
            step = int(fields[2])
        elif kind == "ORDER"
            orders = orders.append([for word := fields[1:][] then int(word)])
        elif kind == "RUN"
            runs = runs.append(RunDefinition(fields[1], fields[2]))
        elif kind == "ANIMATE"
            animate = fields[1]
            frames = int(fields[2])
        else
            delays = delays.append(Delay(int(fields[1]), int(fields[2]), int(fields[3])))
    return Parameters(horizon, high_budget, low_budget, window, step, orders, runs, animate, frames, delays)

bool contains_cell(int[] cells, int wanted)
    for cell := cells[]
        if cell == wanted
            return true
    return false

Mdd build_mdd(grid_map.Grid grid, grid_map.Agent agent, int[] distances, int length, low_level.Prohibitions restrictions)
    int[][] layers := [[agent.start]]
    for: 1 <= tick <= length
        distinct<int> reached
        for source := layers[tick - 1][]
            for destination := grid.destinations[source][]
                if distances[destination] >= 0 and tick + distances[destination] <= length and low_level.action_allowed(restrictions, source, destination, tick)
                    .reached.add(destination)
        layers = layers.append(reached.sorted())
    layers[length] = [agent.goal]
    for: length > tick >= 0
        int[] kept := []
        for source := layers[tick][]
            reaches := false
            for destination := grid.destinations[source][]
                if contains_cell(layers[tick + 1], destination) and low_level.action_allowed(restrictions, source, destination, tick + 1)
                    reaches = true
            if reaches
                kept = kept.append(source)
        layers[tick] = kept
    states := 0
    width := 0
    for layer := layers[]
        states += int(#layer)
        if int(#layer) > width
            width = int(#layer)
    return Mdd(layers, states, width)

int layer_size(Mdd mdd, int tick)
    return if tick >= int(#mdd.layers) then 1 else int(#mdd.layers[tick])

int classify_conflict(cbs.Conflict conflict, Mdd[] mdds)
    first_fixed := layer_size(mdds[conflict.first], conflict.tick) == 1
    second_fixed := layer_size(mdds[conflict.second], conflict.tick) == 1
    if conflict.kind == "edge"
        first_fixed = first_fixed and layer_size(mdds[conflict.first], conflict.tick - 1) == 1
        second_fixed = second_fixed and layer_size(mdds[conflict.second], conflict.tick - 1) == 1
    return if first_fixed and second_fixed then 0 elif first_fixed or second_fixed then 1 else 2

string class_name(int category)
    return if category == 0 then "cardinal" elif category == 1 then "semi_cardinal" else "non_cardinal"

string agent_order(int[] order)
    return [for id := order[] then report.agent_name(id)].join("")

class Overview(int free_cells, int[] degrees, int components, int[] distances, int soc_lower, int makespan_lower, Mdd[] mdds, int[][] independent, cbs.Conflict[] conflicts, int[] conflict_classes, string[] groups)

string[] conflict_groups(cbs.Conflict[] conflicts, int count)
    bool[][] adjacent := []
    for: i < count
        adjacent = adjacent.append(array(nat(count), fill = false))
    for conflict := conflicts[]
        adjacent[conflict.first][conflict.second] = true
        adjacent[conflict.second][conflict.first] = true
    seen := array(nat(count), fill = false)
    string[] result := []
    for: seed < count
        if seen[seed]
            continue
        queue := [seed]
        seen[seed] = true
        cursor := 0
        while cursor < int(#queue)
            current := queue[cursor]
            cursor += 1
            for: other < count
                if adjacent[current][other] and not seen[other]
                    seen[other] = true
                    queue = queue.append(other)
        if #queue > 1
            result = result.append(agent_order(queue.sorted()))
    return result

Overview inspect_instance(grid_map.Grid grid, grid_map.Agent[] agents, int[][] distances, int horizon)
    free_cells := 0
    degrees := [0, 0, 0, 0]
    components := 0
    seen := array(#grid.free, fill = false)
    for: cell < int(#grid.free)
        if not grid.free[cell]
            continue
        free_cells += 1
        degree := grid_map.degree(grid, cell)
        degrees[if degree < 3 then degree else 3] += 1
        if seen[cell]
            continue
        components += 1
        queue := [cell]
        seen[cell] = true
        cursor := 0
        while cursor < int(#queue)
            current := queue[cursor]
            cursor += 1
            for next := grid.destinations[current][]
                if not seen[next]
                    seen[next] = true
                    queue = queue.append(next)
    int[] shortest := []
    soc_lower := 0
    makespan_lower := 0
    Mdd[] mdds := []
    int[][] independent := []
    budget := low_level.Budget(-1)
    for: i < int(#agents)
        distance := distances[i][agents[i].start]
        shortest = shortest.append(distance)
        soc_lower += distance
        if distance > makespan_lower
            makespan_lower = distance
        restrictions := low_level.Prohibitions(int(#grid.free))
        mdds = mdds.append(build_mdd(grid, agents[i], distances[i], distance, restrictions))
        result := low_level.search_path(grid, agents[i], distances[i], agents[i].start, 0, restrictions, horizon, &budget)
        independent = independent.append(result.path)
    cbs.Conflict[] conflicts := cbs.find_conflicts(independent)
    conflict_classes := [for conflict := conflicts[] then classify_conflict(conflict, mdds)]
    return Overview(free_cells, degrees, components, shortest, soc_lower, makespan_lower, mdds, independent, conflicts, conflict_classes, conflict_groups(conflicts, int(#agents)))

void solve_pp(Run &run, grid_map.Grid grid, grid_map.Agent[] agents, int[][] distances, Parameters settings)
    for: index < int(#settings.orders)
        number := index + 1
        run.high_level += 1
        int beginning := run.budget.expansions
        result := prioritized.try_order(grid, agents, distances, settings.horizon, settings.orders[index], &run.budget)
        planned := 0
        for attempt := result.attempts[]
            prefix := "order {number} agent " + report.agent_name(attempt.agent)
            if attempt.result.status == "ok"
                planned += 1
                run.trace = run.trace.append(prefix + " cost {int(#attempt.result.path) - 1} expansions {attempt.result.expansions}")
            else
                run.trace = run.trace.append(prefix + " failed expansions {attempt.result.expansions}")
        if result.status == "ll_budget"
            run.reason = "ll_budget"
            return
        suffix := if result.status == "ok" then "ok" else "failed " + report.agent_name(result.failed_agent)
        run.specific = run.specific.append("order {number} " + agent_order(settings.orders[index]) + " planned {planned} expansions {run.budget.expansions - beginning} {suffix}")
        if result.status == "ok"
            run.success = true
            run.answer_order = number
            run.paths = result.paths
            return
    run.reason = "orders"

void apply_constraint(low_level.Prohibitions &restrictions, cbs.Constraint addition)
    cells := restrictions.cell_count
    if addition.kind == "vertex"
        .restrictions.states.add(addition.tick * cells + addition.source)
    else
        .restrictions.moves.add((addition.tick * cells + addition.source) * cells + addition.destination)

void solve_cbs(Run &run, grid_map.Grid grid, grid_map.Agent[] agents, int[][] distances, Parameters settings)
    run.generated = 0
    int[][] paths := []
    low_level.Prohibitions[] constraints := []
    for: i < int(#agents)
        restrictions := low_level.Prohibitions(int(#grid.free))
        constraints = constraints.append(restrictions)
        result := low_level.search_path(grid, agents[i], distances[i], agents[i].start, 0, restrictions, settings.horizon, &run.budget)
        if result.status == "aborted"
            run.reason = "ll_budget"
            return
        paths = paths.append(result.path)
    root := cbs.create_node(paths, constraints, 0, 0, -1, run.definition.cost_function)
    heap := [root]
    run.generated = 1
    while #heap != 0
        node := cbs.pop_node(&heap)
        run.open_count = int(#heap)
        if #node.conflicts == 0
            run.success = true
            run.paths = node.paths
            run.answer_number = node.number
            run.answer_depth = node.depth
            run.constraints = node.constraints
            return
        if run.high_level == settings.high_budget
            run.reason = "hl_budget"
            return
        run.high_level += 1
        chosen := 0
        category := -1
        if run.definition.solver == "ICBS"
            Mdd[] mdds := []
            for: i < int(#agents)
                mdds = mdds.append(build_mdd(grid, agents[i], distances[i], int(#node.paths[i]) - 1, node.constraints[i]))
            category = 3
            for: i < int(#node.conflicts)
                current := classify_conflict(node.conflicts[i], mdds)
                if current < category
                    category = current
                    chosen = i
            run.classes[category] += 1
        cbs.Conflict conflict := node.conflicts[chosen]
        cbs.Constraint[] additions := cbs.split_constraints(conflict)
        children := ["-", "-"]
        for: branch < 2
            addition := additions[branch]
            next_constraints := node.constraints
            apply_constraint(&next_constraints[addition.agent], addition)
            result := low_level.search_path(grid, agents[addition.agent], distances[addition.agent], agents[addition.agent].start, 0, next_constraints[addition.agent], settings.horizon, &run.budget)
            if result.status == "aborted"
                run.reason = "ll_budget"
                run.open_count = int(#heap)
                return
            if result.status != "ok"
                run.pruned += 1
                continue
            next_paths := node.paths
            next_paths[addition.agent] = result.path
            child := cbs.create_node(next_paths, next_constraints, run.generated, node.depth + 1, node.number, run.definition.cost_function)
            children[branch] = string(run.generated)
            run.generated += 1
            cbs.push_node(&heap, child)
        run.open_count = int(#heap)
        parent := if node.parent < 0 then "-" else string(node.parent)
        split := report.conflict_text(conflict, grid.width)
        if category >= 0
            split += " class " + class_name(category)
        run.trace = run.trace.append("expand {run.high_level} node {node.number} parent {parent} depth {node.depth} cost {node.cost} conflicts {#node.conflicts} split {split} children {children[0]} {children[1]}")
    run.reason = "exhausted"

void solve_whca(Run &run, grid_map.Grid grid, grid_map.Agent[] agents, int[][] distances, Parameters settings)
    positions := [for agent := agents[] then agent.start]
    int[][] executed := [for agent := agents[] then [agent.start]]
    start_tick := 0
    while true
        finished := true
        for: i < int(#agents)
            finished = finished and positions[i] == agents[i].goal
        if finished
            for: i < int(#agents)
                while #executed[i] > 1 and executed[i][-2] == agents[i].goal
                    executed[i] = executed[i][0:<int(#executed[i]) - 1]
            run.paths = executed
            run.success = true
            return
        if start_tick >= settings.horizon
            run.reason = "timeout"
            return
        run.high_level += 1
        restrictions := low_level.Prohibitions(int(#grid.free))
        int[] order := []
        for: i < int(#agents)
            if positions[i] != agents[i].goal
                order = order.append(i)
        for: i < int(#agents)
            if positions[i] == agents[i].goal
                order = order.append(i)
        int[][] windows := []
        for agent := agents[]
            windows = windows.append([])
        for i := order[]
            result := low_level.search_path(grid, agents[i], distances[i], positions[i], start_tick, restrictions, start_tick + settings.window, &run.budget, true)
            if result.status == "aborted"
                run.reason = "ll_budget"
                return
            prefix := "round {run.high_level} time {start_tick} agent " + report.agent_name(i)
            if result.status != "ok"
                run.trace = run.trace.append(prefix + " blocked expansions {result.expansions}")
                run.reason = "blocked"
                return
            path := result.path
            while int(#path) < settings.window + 1
                path = path.append(path[-1])
            windows[i] = path
            run.trace = run.trace.append(prefix + " moves " + report.action_string(path, grid.width) + " expansions {result.expansions}")
            low_level.reserve_path(&restrictions, path, start_tick)
        for: i < int(#agents)
            executed[i] = executed[i].concat(windows[i][1:settings.step])
            positions[i] = windows[i][settings.step]
        start_tick += settings.step

AgentMetrics path_metrics(int[] path, int goal, int lower, int width)
    length := int(#path) - 1
    waits := 0
    turns := 0
    arrival := -1
    leaves := 0
    previous := ""
    for: tick < int(#path)
        if path[tick] == goal and arrival < 0
            arrival = tick
        if tick == 0
            continue
        action := report.action_name(path[tick - 1], path[tick], width)
        if action == "."
            waits += 1
        else
            if previous != "" and previous != action
                turns += 1
            previous = action
        if path[tick - 1] == goal and path[tick] != goal
            leaves += 1
    return AgentMetrics(length, length - lower, waits, turns, arrival, leaves, report.action_string(path, width))

PlanMetrics plan_metrics(int[][] paths, grid_map.Grid grid, grid_map.Agent[] agents, Overview overview, string cost_function)
    result := PlanMetrics()
    result.soc = cbs.plan_soc(paths)
    result.makespan = cbs.plan_makespan(paths)
    result.cost = if cost_function == "SOC" then result.soc else result.makespan
    result.traffic = array(#grid.free, fill = 0)
    result.cell_waits = array(#grid.free, fill = 0)
    for: i < int(#agents)
        metrics := path_metrics(paths[i], agents[i].goal, overview.distances[i], grid.width)
        result.agents = result.agents.append(metrics)
        result.sum_extra += metrics.extra
        if metrics.extra > result.max_extra
            result.max_extra = metrics.extra
        result.waits += metrics.waits
        result.turns += metrics.turns
        distinct<int> visited
        for cell := paths[i][]
            .visited.add(cell)
        for cell := visited.values()[]
            result.traffic[cell] += 1
        for: 1 <= tick < int(#paths[i])
            if paths[i][tick] == paths[i][tick - 1]
                result.cell_waits[paths[i][tick]] += 1
    for: tick <= result.makespan
        count := 0
        for path := paths[]
            if int(#path) - 1 <= tick
                count += 1
        result.arrivals = result.arrivals.append(count)
    selected := array(#grid.free, fill = false)
    for: rank < 5
        best := -1
        for: cell < int(#grid.free)
            if not selected[cell] and result.traffic[cell] > 0 and (best < 0 or result.traffic[cell] > result.traffic[best])
                best = cell
        if best < 0
            break
        selected[best] = true
        result.hotspots = result.hotspots.append(best)
    return result

class ExecutionStep(int scheduled, int cell)
class Prerequisite(int agent, int step)

Execution delayed_execution(int[][] paths, Delay[] delays)
    result := Execution()
    ExecutionStep[][] steps := []
    for path := paths[]
        current := [ExecutionStep(0, path[0])]
        for: 1 <= tick < int(#path)
            if path[tick] != path[tick - 1]
                current = current.append(ExecutionStep(tick, path[tick]))
        steps = steps.append(current)
    Prerequisite[][][] prerequisites := []
    for: i < int(#paths)
        Prerequisite[][] per_agent := []
        for target := steps[i][]
            Prerequisite[] required := []
            for: j < int(#paths)
                if i == j
                    continue
                for: index < int(#steps[j])
                    earlier := steps[j][index]
                    if earlier.cell == target.cell and earlier.scheduled < target.scheduled
                        required = required.append(Prerequisite(j, index))
            per_agent = per_agent.append(required)
        prerequisites = prerequisites.append(per_agent)
    progress := array(#paths, fill = 0)
    result.finish = array(#paths, fill = 0)
    tick := 0
    while true
        all_finished := true
        for: i < int(#paths)
            if progress[i] < int(#steps[i]) - 1
                all_finished = false
        if all_finished
            break
        int[] advancing := []
        stopped_any := false
        for: i < int(#paths)
            if progress[i] == int(#steps[i]) - 1
                continue
            stopped := false
            for delay := delays[]
                if delay.agent == i and delay.start <= tick and tick < delay.start + delay.duration
                    stopped = true
            if stopped
                stopped_any = true
                continue
            ready := true
            for required := prerequisites[i][progress[i] + 1][]
                if progress[required.agent] <= required.step
                    ready = false
            if ready
                advancing = advancing.append(i)
            else
                result.blocked += 1
        if #advancing == 0 and not stopped_any
            result.deadlock = true
            result.cutoff = tick
            return result
        for i := advancing[]
            progress[i] += 1
            result.finish[i] = tick + 1
        tick += 1
    for finish := result.finish[]
        result.soc += finish
        if finish > result.makespan
            result.makespan = finish
    return result

Run[] run_solvers(grid_map.Grid grid, grid_map.Agent[] agents, int[][] distances, Parameters settings, Overview overview)
    Run[] results := []
    for definition := settings.runs[]
        run := Run(definition, settings.low_budget)
        if definition.solver == "PP"
            solve_pp(&run, grid, agents, distances, settings)
        elif definition.solver == "WHCA"
            solve_whca(&run, grid, agents, distances, settings)
        else
            solve_cbs(&run, grid, agents, distances, settings)
        if run.success
            run.metrics = plan_metrics(run.paths, grid, agents, overview, definition.cost_function)
            run.execution = delayed_execution(run.paths, settings.delays)
            string ending
            if definition.solver == "PP"
                ending = "end OK order {run.answer_order}"
            elif definition.solver == "WHCA"
                ending = "end OK rounds {run.high_level}"
            else
                ending = "end OK node {run.answer_number} cost {run.metrics.cost}"
            run.trace = run.trace.append(ending)
        else
            run.trace = run.trace.append("end FAIL " + run.reason)
        results = results.append(run)
    return results

string[] instance_lines(grid_map.Grid grid, grid_map.Agent[] agents, Overview overview)
    lines := ["instance width {grid.width} height {grid.height} free {overview.free_cells} agents {#agents}", "map isolated {overview.degrees[0]} dead_ends {overview.degrees[1]} corridors {overview.degrees[2]} junctions {overview.degrees[3]} components {overview.components}"]
    for: i < int(#agents)
        agent := agents[i]
        lines = lines.append("agent {agent.name} start " + report.cell_text(agent.start, grid.width) + " goal " + report.cell_text(agent.goal, grid.width) + " distance {overview.distances[i]} mdd {overview.mdds[i].states} width {overview.mdds[i].width}")
    lines = lines.append("lower_bound soc {overview.soc_lower} makespan {overview.makespan_lower}")
    vertices := 0
    edges := 0
    classes := [0, 0, 0]
    for: i < int(#overview.conflicts)
        if overview.conflicts[i].kind == "vertex"
            vertices += 1
        else
            edges += 1
        classes[overview.conflict_classes[i]] += 1
    lines = lines.append("independent conflicts {#overview.conflicts} vertex {vertices} edge {edges} cardinal {classes[0]} semi_cardinal {classes[1]} non_cardinal {classes[2]}")
    return lines.append("groups " + (if #overview.groups == 0 then "-" else overview.groups.join(" ")))

bool constraint_before(cbs.Constraint first, cbs.Constraint second, int width)
    a := [first.agent, first.tick, if first.kind == "vertex" then 0 else 1, first.source % width, first.source / width, first.destination % width, first.destination / width]
    b := [second.agent, second.tick, if second.kind == "vertex" then 0 else 1, second.source % width, second.source / width, second.destination % width, second.destination / width]
    for: i < int(#a)
        if a[i] != b[i]
            return a[i] < b[i]
    return false

cbs.Constraint[] ordered_constraints(low_level.Prohibitions[] restrictions, int width)
    cbs.Constraint[] result := []
    for: agent < int(#restrictions)
        cells := restrictions[agent].cell_count
        for key := restrictions[agent].states.values()[]
            cell := key % cells
            result = result.append(cbs.Constraint(agent, "vertex", key / cells, cell, cell))
        for key := restrictions[agent].moves.values()[]
            destination := key % cells
            source := (key / cells) % cells
            result = result.append(cbs.Constraint(agent, "edge", key / cells / cells, source, destination))
    for: 1 <= i < int(#result)
        j := i
        while j > 0 and constraint_before(result[j], result[j - 1], width)
            temporary := result[j - 1]
            result[j - 1] = result[j]
            result[j] = temporary
            j -= 1
    return result

string[] solver_lines(Run run, Parameters settings, int width)
    if run.definition.solver == "PP"
        return run.specific
    if run.definition.solver == "WHCA"
        return ["window {settings.window} step {settings.step} rounds {run.high_level}"]
    lines := ["search expanded {run.high_level} generated {run.generated} pruned {run.pruned} open {run.open_count}"]
    if run.definition.solver == "ICBS"
        lines = lines.append("classes cardinal {run.classes[0]} semi_cardinal {run.classes[1]} non_cardinal {run.classes[2]}")
    if run.success
        lines = lines.append("solution node {run.answer_number} depth {run.answer_depth}")
        for constraint := ordered_constraints(run.constraints, width)[]
            beginning := "constraint " + report.agent_name(constraint.agent) + " {constraint.kind} " + report.cell_text(constraint.source, width)
            if constraint.kind == "edge"
                beginning += " " + report.cell_text(constraint.destination, width)
            lines = lines.append(beginning + " t {constraint.tick}")
    return lines

string[] successful_lines(Run run, grid_map.Grid grid, grid_map.Agent[] agents)
    string[] lines := []
    for: i < int(#agents)
        AgentMetrics metrics := run.metrics.agents[i]
        lines = lines.append("agent {agents[i].name} cost {metrics.cost} extra {metrics.extra} waits {metrics.waits} turns {metrics.turns} arrive {metrics.arrival} leave {metrics.leaves} moves {metrics.actions}")
    lines = lines.append("arrivals " + [for count := run.metrics.arrivals[] then string(count)].join(" "))
    string[] hotspots := []
    for cell := run.metrics.hotspots[]
        hotspots = hotspots.append(report.cell_text(cell, grid.width) + ":{run.metrics.traffic[cell]}")
    lines = lines.append("hotspots " + hotspots.join(" "))
    if run.execution.deadlock
        lines = lines.append("execution deadlock time {run.execution.cutoff}")
    else
        lines = lines.append("execution soc {run.execution.soc} makespan {run.execution.makespan} blocked {run.execution.blocked} finish " + [for tick := run.execution.finish[] then string(tick)].join(" "))
    return lines

string[] solution_lines(grid_map.Grid grid, grid_map.Agent[] agents, Overview overview, Run[] results, Parameters settings)
    lines := instance_lines(grid, agents, overview)
    int[] successful := []
    for: i < int(#results)
        run := results[i]
        lines = lines.append("")
        prefix := "run {run.name} solver {run.definition.solver} cost_function {run.definition.cost_function} result "
        if run.success
            successful = successful.append(i)
            lower := if run.definition.cost_function == "SOC" then overview.soc_lower else overview.makespan_lower
            lines = lines.append(prefix + "OK cost {run.metrics.cost} soc {run.metrics.soc} makespan {run.metrics.makespan} ratio " + report.fraction_text(run.metrics.cost, lower))
        else
            lines = lines.append(prefix + "FAIL reason " + run.reason)
        lines = lines.concat(solver_lines(run, settings, grid.width))
        if run.success
            lines = lines.concat(successful_lines(run, grid, agents))
    lines = lines.concat(["", "summary ok {#successful} failed {int(#results) - int(#successful)}"])
    if #successful == 0
        return lines
    int best_soc := results[successful[0]].metrics.soc
    int best_makespan := results[successful[0]].metrics.makespan
    for index := successful[]
        if results[index].metrics.soc < best_soc
            best_soc = results[index].metrics.soc
        if results[index].metrics.makespan < best_makespan
            best_makespan = results[index].metrics.makespan
    string[] soc_names := []
    string[] makespan_names := []
    for index := successful[]
        if results[index].metrics.soc == best_soc
            soc_names = soc_names.append(results[index].name)
        if results[index].metrics.makespan == best_makespan
            makespan_names = makespan_names.append(results[index].name)
    ranking := successful
    for: 1 <= i < int(#ranking)
        j := i
        while j > 0
            PlanMetrics a := results[ranking[j]].metrics
            PlanMetrics b := results[ranking[j - 1]].metrics
            earlier := a.soc < b.soc or (a.soc == b.soc and a.makespan < b.makespan)
            if not earlier
                break
            temporary := ranking[j - 1]
            ranking[j - 1] = ranking[j]
            ranking[j] = temporary
            j -= 1
    return lines.concat(["best_soc {best_soc} " + soc_names.join(" "), "best_makespan {best_makespan} " + makespan_names.join(" "), "ranking " + [for index := ranking[] then results[index].name].join(" ")])

string[] stats_lines(Run[] results)
    lines := ["run,solver,cost_function,result,reason,cost,soc,makespan,sum_extra,max_extra,waits,turns,exec_soc,exec_makespan,high_level,generated,searches,expansions"]
    for run := results[]
        fields := [run.name, run.definition.solver, run.definition.cost_function, if run.success then "OK" else "FAIL", if run.success then "-" else run.reason]
        if run.success
            PlanMetrics metrics := run.metrics
            fields = fields.concat([string(metrics.cost), string(metrics.soc), string(metrics.makespan), string(metrics.sum_extra), string(metrics.max_extra), string(metrics.waits), string(metrics.turns), if run.execution.deadlock then "-" else string(run.execution.soc), if run.execution.deadlock then "-" else string(run.execution.makespan)])
        else
            fields = fields.concat(["-", "-", "-", "-", "-", "-", "-", "-", "-"])
        fields = fields.concat([string(run.high_level), if run.generated < 0 then "-" else string(run.generated), string(run.budget.searches), string(run.budget.expansions)])
        lines = lines.append(report.csv_line(fields))
    return lines

string[] validate_plan(string name, int[][] paths, grid_map.Grid grid, grid_map.Agent[] agents, int[] classes)
    starts := 0
    goals := 0
    moves := 0
    for: i < int(#agents)
        if paths[i][0] != agents[i].start
            starts += 1
        if paths[i][-1] != agents[i].goal
            goals += 1
        for: 1 <= tick < int(#paths[i])
            if not contains_cell(grid.destinations[paths[i][tick - 1]], paths[i][tick])
                moves += 1
    cbs.Conflict[] conflicts := cbs.find_conflicts(paths)
    vertices := 0
    edges := 0
    for conflict := conflicts[]
        if conflict.kind == "vertex"
            vertices += 1
        else
            edges += 1
    follows := 0
    horizon := cbs.plan_makespan(paths)
    for: 1 <= tick <= horizon
        for: first < int(#agents)
            current := cbs.path_position(paths[first], tick)
            previous := cbs.path_position(paths[first], tick - 1)
            if current == previous
                continue
            for: second < int(#agents)
                if first != second and current == cbs.path_position(paths[second], tick - 1) and cbs.path_position(paths[second], tick) != previous
                    follows += 1
    verdict := if starts + goals + moves + vertices + edges == 0 then "VALID" else "INVALID"
    lines := ["plan {name} verdict {verdict} start {starts} goal {goals} moves {moves} vertex {vertices} edge {edges} follows {follows}"]
    for: i < int(#conflicts)
        line := "  " + report.conflict_text(conflicts[i], grid.width)
        if #classes > 0
            line += " " + class_name(classes[i])
        lines = lines.append(line)
    return lines

string[] validation_lines(Run[] results, grid_map.Grid grid, grid_map.Agent[] agents, Overview overview)
    lines := validate_plan("INDEPENDENT", overview.independent, grid, agents, overview.conflict_classes)
    for run := results[]
        if run.success
            lines = lines.concat(validate_plan(run.name, run.paths, grid, agents, []))
        else
            lines = lines.append("plan {run.name} verdict NONE")
    return lines

string[] trace_lines(Run[] results)
    string[] lines := []
    for: i < int(#results)
        if i > 0
            lines = lines.append("")
        lines = lines.concat(results[i].trace)
    return lines

string[] occupancy_picture(grid_map.Grid grid, grid_map.Agent[] agents, int[][] paths, int tick)
    string[] cells := []
    for: cell < int(#grid.free)
        cells = cells.append(if grid.free[cell] then "." else "@")
    lower_names := "abcdefghijklmnopqrst"
    for: i < int(#agents)
        cells[agents[i].goal] = lower_names[i]
    for: i < int(#agents)
        cells[cbs.path_position(paths[i], tick)] = agents[i].name
    string[] rows := []
    for: y < grid.height
        rows = rows.append(cells[y * grid.width:<(y + 1) * grid.width].join(""))
    return rows

string[] count_picture(grid_map.Grid grid, int[] counts)
    string[] cells := []
    for: cell < int(#grid.free)
        character := if not grid.free[cell] then "@" elif counts[cell] == 0 then "." elif counts[cell] < 10 then string(counts[cell]) else "+"
        cells = cells.append(character)
    string[] rows := []
    for: y < grid.height
        rows = rows.append(cells[y * grid.width:<(y + 1) * grid.width].join(""))
    return rows

string[] animation_lines(Run[] results, grid_map.Grid grid, grid_map.Agent[] agents, Parameters settings)
    selected := 0
    for: i < int(#results)
        if results[i].name == settings.animate
            selected = i
    run := results[selected]
    if not run.success
        return ["run {run.name} FAIL"]
    lines := ["run {run.name} frames {settings.frames}"]
    for: tick < settings.frames
        done := 0
        moving := 0
        waiting := 0
        for path := run.paths[]
            length := int(#path) - 1
            if tick >= length
                done += 1
            elif tick >= 1 and cbs.path_position(path, tick) != cbs.path_position(path, tick - 1)
                moving += 1
            else
                waiting += 1
        lines = lines.concat(["", "frame {tick} done {done} moving {moving} waiting {waiting}"]).concat(occupancy_picture(grid, agents, run.paths, tick))
    return lines.concat(["", "traffic"]).concat(count_picture(grid, run.metrics.traffic)).concat(["", "waits"]).concat(count_picture(grid, run.metrics.cell_waits))

void run_program()
    grid := grid_map.read_grid()
    grid_map.Agent[] agents := grid_map.read_agents(grid)
    settings := read_parameters(int(#agents))
    distances := [for agent := agents[] then grid_map.distance_table(grid, agent.goal)]
    overview := inspect_instance(grid, agents, distances, settings.horizon)
    results := run_solvers(grid, agents, distances, settings, overview)
    bool directory_exists := file.is_directory("output")
    if not directory_exists
        file.mkdir("output")
    report.write_lines("solutions.txt", solution_lines(grid, agents, overview, results, settings))
    report.write_lines("stats.csv", stats_lines(results))
    report.write_lines("validation.txt", validation_lines(results, grid, agents, overview))
    report.write_lines("trace.txt", trace_lines(results))
    report.write_lines("frames.txt", animation_lines(results, grid, agents, settings))

run_program()

import grid_map = "./grid_map.qui"
import low_level = "./low_level.qui"

class Attempt(int agent, low_level.SearchResult result)
class OrderResult(string status, int failed_agent, int[][] paths, Attempt[] attempts)

OrderResult try_order(grid_map.Grid grid, grid_map.Agent[] agents, int[][] distances, int horizon, int[] order, low_level.Budget &budget)
    restrictions := low_level.Prohibitions(int(#grid.free))
    int[][] paths := []
    for agent := agents[]
        paths = paths.append([])
    Attempt[] attempts := []
    for agent_id := order[]
        result := low_level.search_path(grid, agents[agent_id], distances[agent_id], agents[agent_id].start, 0, restrictions, horizon, &budget)
        if result.status == "aborted"
            return OrderResult("ll_budget", agent_id, [], attempts)
        attempts = attempts.append(Attempt(agent_id, result))
        if result.status != "ok"
            return OrderResult("failed", agent_id, [], attempts)
        paths[agent_id] = result.path
        low_level.reserve_path(&restrictions, result.path, 0, true)
    return OrderResult("ok", -1, paths, attempts)

import grid_map = "./grid_map.qui"
import cbs = "./cbs.qui"

string cell_text(int cell, int width)
    return "{cell % width},{cell / width}"

string agent_name(int number)
    names := "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRST"
    return names[number]

string action_name(int source, int destination, int width)
    dx := destination % width - source % width
    dy := destination / width - source / width
    return if dx == 0 and dy == 0 then "." elif dy == -1 then "N" elif dx == 1 then "E" elif dy == 1 then "S" else "W"

string action_string(int[] path, int width)
    result := ""
    for: 1 <= i < int(#path)
        result += action_name(path[i - 1], path[i], width)
    return result

string conflict_text(cbs.Conflict conflict, int width)
    beginning := "{conflict.kind} t {conflict.tick} " + agent_name(conflict.first) + " " + agent_name(conflict.second)
    if conflict.kind == "vertex"
        return beginning + " at " + cell_text(conflict.source, width)
    return beginning + " from " + cell_text(conflict.source, width) + " to " + cell_text(conflict.destination, width)

int greatest_divisor(int first, int second)
    a := first
    b := second
    while b != 0
        a, b = b, a % b
    return a

string fraction_text(int numerator, int denominator)
    divisor := greatest_divisor(numerator, denominator)
    return "{numerator / divisor}/{denominator / divisor}"

string csv_line(string[] values)
    return values.join(",")

void write_lines(string filename, string[] lines)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + filename)
    .writer1(lines.join(NL) + NL)
